Florida Gators Basketball Player Suffers Shoulder Injury During Game

Boogie Fland, a guard for the No. 1 Florida Gators men's basketball team, sustained an apparent shoulder injury during a game against the Notre Dame Fighting Irish. Fland left the game due to the injury.
